title: ZUS Coffee stars take part in exhibition match at inauguration of volleyball courts
summary: Players from the ZUS Coffee Thunderbelles took part in a meet-and-greet and an exhibition match to highlight the inauguration of a new volleyball facility in Guiguinto, Bulacan on Saturday.
